gbm_population_evidence.quote: MRI obtained within 30 days of study enrollment documents a measurable lesion consistent with a primary malignant central nervous system tumor for which maximal safe resection is indicated

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is named only in keywords; inclusion covers primary malignant CNS tumours generally, so a GBM-eligible basket reading is possible but C7 does not allow keywords.

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to examine the use of a single dose of tozuleristide (24 or 36 mg) and the Canvas imaging system during surgical resection of primary central nervous system (CNS) tumors

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects with prior therapy are eligible provided they have recovered from any acute toxic effects of prior therapy and have sufficient time interval prior to enrollment.

role_evidence.quote: Fluorescence Detection of Adult Primary Central Nervous System Tumors With Tozuleristide and the Canvas System
tozuleristide 24 or 36 mg administered intravenously 1-24 hours prior to surgery

agents.drug_class_hint: fluorescent tumour-targeting peptide-dye conjugate (chlorotoxin-ICG, BLZ-100) for fluorescence-guided surgery

coder_notes: Fluorescence-guided surgery imaging study; tozuleristide is a diagnostic/visualisation agent -> no pharmacological candidate. Glioblastoma appears only in keywords (not conditions, title, inclusion or arm labels), so per C7 coded not_glioblastoma (population: primary malignant CNS tumours and vestibular schwannoma); flagged uncertain because a reviewer might code basket_gbm_eligible. Trial fails S6 either way. Treatment setting not stated (prior therapy allowed but not required) -> unclear.
